name: New green cards (lawful permanent residents) by county, country of birth and class of admission
description: New lawful permanent residents (green card holders) in the 200 U.S. counties with the most, for the two latest fiscal years: admissions by class (immediate relatives, family preference, employment preference, diversity, refugee and asylee adjustments, other) and the ten countries of birth with the most, with state sums set against the Yearbook of Immigration Statistics state totals. Read from the Department of Homeland Security's county workbooks, in which every cell is rounded to the nearest 10; sums are of rounded cells and understate the true figures, and the share of each state's total they cover is given.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). New green cards (lawful permanent residents) by county, country of birth and class of admission (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963657
keywords: new lawful permanent residents by county
LPR admissions by country of birth county
OHSS lawful permanent residents top 200 counties

distribution.name: green-cards.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: green-cards.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: green-cards-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in green-cards-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to green-cards.csv on id.

recordSet.name: green-cards
recordSet.description: The records of New green cards (lawful permanent residents) by county, country of birth and class of admission, one per CSV row.

field.name: diversity

field.description: Other classes of admission

field.description: Same as admissions_listed

field.name: unit
field.description: What value counts

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: First day of the fiscal year

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Last day of the fiscal year

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: Date the OHSS files were last read

field.name: sourceLabels
